name: Tenth Brother's shoto lightsabers
description: The Tenth Brother's shoto lightsabers were two shoto lightsabers used by the Tenth Brother, an Inquisitor in the Galactic Empire's Jedi-hunting organization, the Inquisitorius. Previously using a green-bladed lightsaber during his time as a Jedi in 22 BBY, he wielded the shoto lightsabers as an Inquisitor in 18 BBY during a mission to the planet Mon Cala, where he met his end. The lightsabers featured a handguard and produced red-colored blades from their kyber crystals.
